source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Obtain and carefully review all inspection records related to the failed audit. Pay particular attention to sections where safety regulations were not met and where violations were documented. Keep the original records as evidence and make copies for use in your report.

3. List all violations and non-conformities.
Compile a comprehensive list of all specific violations, non-conformities, and safety concerns identified during the audit. Categorize them according to severity, the section of the safety code they relate to, and potential risks involved.

4. Identify root causes.
Conduct a detailed analysis to determine the root causes behind the audit failures. Investigate processes, procedures, equipment, training, and any other relevant variables that may have contributed to the non-compliance.

5. Collect evidence and supporting documentation.
Gather all relevant evidence and documentation that support the findings and conclusions of the audit. This may include photographs, video footage, maintenance logs, training records, and incident reports, among
